predictions: Hmmm… this isn't a great trend growing here. 18-8 in week 1, 17-9 in week 2, and now 16-10 in week 3. Crap. Need to flip that trend. As per usual, I lost a whole bunch of close ones (even dropping two of them in a tiebreaker), but that's not news anymore. I'm now at 51-27 (65.4% correct) so far, which is still… decent. The problem for me is that Main Street Mayhem in D, Cheap Shots in E, and Dart Bags in F, are all still here… I'm 0-3 to this point with each of those teams! Grrr.

Match of the week: (A Div.) Dart Vader @ Show Me Your Tips. Ok, here we go… round 1 of 6 this season in the super-series that is the matchups between the league's top three heavyweights. Winner here takes the early edge in what will likely be the best A race we have seen in years. It's impressive how much better Show Me has become, but Vader's lineup can be fairly described as downright scary. Vader, 14-10.

Match #2: (G Div.) Flight Club @ 21 Dart Salute. These two somewhat long-term middle-of-the pack G teams each made a pickup or two, and boom, it's a battle of undefeateds. These teams have already opened a 9+-point advantage on everybody else, so this winner has strong early control of this race. This one is going the distance… Salute in a 1001.

Match #3: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Dart Knights. Ton 80 sits at 3-0 in the lead duo, whole the Knights have already suffered a loss and are a few points behind as well. But… the Knights have already had to face the Dartifacts, so who the real #2 here is very much in question. A question that might be answered right here. Knights squeak a 13-11.

Match #4: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Liquor Possee. The Possee sits alone atop C at 3-0, but the Niners are part of a garden party of teams just one win and a handful of points behind. I had really planned on taking the Niners in this one, but then Ed Kusko popped up on The Possee's roster. Sooo, yeah, I'll be taking the Possee instead, 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Bottoms Up. Menace has fought to a 2-1 record in a whole series of tight battles so far. But the Bottoms have pretty much rolled to their 3-0. As said in the preseason, I'm pretty much taking the Bottoms until I have reason not to… 15-9.

Matches #6 & #7: (F Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Nein Mark; Death Throw @ Heart of Dartness. Alright, potentially a defining night in F. The only two 3-0s take on the only two 2-1s. Two teams could basically end the drama for the rest of the division. Or… the other two teams could turn this race into an absolute free-for-all mess of 2-1 teams. With as much as I love drama stories, the mess would be great. Alas, these two are Nein Mark and Dartness, both by 14-10s.

Match #8: (A Div.) Inconsistent Consistently @ Why So Serious? The fight among the bottom four in A is going be nasty. And it's also going to determine who can say they are one of the four best teams in the entirety of RDL. That's huge stuff. Inconsistent, 13-11.

Match #9: (C Div.) Pints & Points @ Shooter McGavin. Remember that garden party of teams I mentioned in match #4? Well, here are two of them, with the winner establishing themselves as a player in the C title chase. This is a tough call, but I'm taking the Pints, 13-11.

Match #10: (D Div.) Duck Fook @ Main Street Mayhem. If the Bottoms handle business over in match #5, the winner of this match will be the only competitor within a match of them. I always get the Mayhem wrong, so congrats to them… I'll take the Ducks, 13-11.
Match #11: (B Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Hump Day! Hump Day got the huge 1001 win last week, and get rewarded by facing a super experienced and talented Stumble. I'll still take Hump, 14-10.

Match #12: (D Div.) Lonerider @ That's What She Said. Yep, this pair is both 1-2. But only one D team is more than one math ahead of them. Definitely still in the thick of it. I'm going Lonerider, 14-10.
